verdict.rationale: SavvyCal's core product is shareable scheduling links. Recipients see open times in a week view, and those times are checked for conflicts against all connected Google, Microsoft, iCloud and Fastmail calendars. Bookings made through a link are recorded as events, and invitees can even overlay their own calendar to pick a time without any back-and-forth. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration (all evidence is vendor-claimed, including a testimonial on the pricing page).

support.subject: As a founder, I can share a booking link where invitees pick a time from my live availability — no back-and-forth email

citations.quote: We've replaced the "click-a-day, then click-a-time" routine with a high-fidelity week view, so recipients see every option at once.
Google, Microsoft, iCloud, and Fastmail, all checked for conflicts
People booking with you can overlay their own Google, Microsoft, or Fastmail calendar on your open times, and pick a time that works without switching tabs.
